policy.project_owned_future_native_policy: Every project-owned governed repository is expected to become C-based and operate independently over time. Adopt the secure native profile before implementation exists; current absence of C or C++ is not an exemption.
policy.third_party_policy: Do not rewrite upstream policy in mirrored or vendored repositories. Track local patch policy separately.
policy.ratchet_rule: Retained review-required operations must receive repository-owned dispositions. After migration, new, unresolved, source-drifted, or stale review findings block merge; AES-banned APIs continue to block immediately.
